new_material_candidates.name: LaMer — Meta-RL Induces Exploration in Language Agents
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Peer-reviewed Meta-RL method that explicitly trains language agents for exploration across environments and performs in-context policy adaptation from test-time feedback without gradient updates.

new_material_candidates.name: Adaptive Debiasing Tsallis Entropy
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Introduces adaptive class-specific Tsallis entropy and label adjustment for VLM TTA, making its uncertainty-selection mechanism materially different from existing Shannon-entropy and cache-based candidates.

n_h2_reference_research.name: LaMer — Meta-RL Induces Exploration in Language Agents
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Learns exploration behavior across related language-agent environments and adapts in context from feedback at test time.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: No verified experiment transfers the learned decision mechanism into Hetren's E2 structured-ML or E3 vision families.

n_h2_reference_research.name: Relational Task Extrapolator
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Learns relations among tasks for extrapolation to unseen tasks.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: Task-relation extrapolation is not evidence of one decision policy spanning E1, E2, and E3.

n_h2_reference_research.name: Learning-To-Measure
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Meta-learns feature-acquisition decisions over structured-data tasks.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: Its verified transfer scope remains E2 active feature acquisition.

screened_not_promoted.name: TF-TTCL
screened_not_promoted.reason: Peer-reviewed training-free online adaptation for LLM reasoning, but the verified evaluation concerns reasoning tasks rather than a matched interactive-agent environment contract.

screened_not_promoted.name: CURE
screened_not_promoted.reason: Peer-reviewed test-time self-improvement for LLM reasoning, but the currently verified setup is not an interactive agent-environment baseline comparable to GTTA, LaMer, AgentGym, or related E1 candidates.

screened_not_promoted.name: BPFedCTTA
screened_not_promoted.reason: Requires a federated continual client/global-model setting that has not been declared as an applicable Hetren E3 experiment.

screened_not_promoted.name: IMA and TMA
screened_not_promoted.reason: Material lightweight VLM adaptation research, but workshop-level evidence does not currently displace the stronger peer-reviewed claim-bearing VLM pool; retain as a diagnostic/reference possibility.
